# Conformal intervals per regime — calibrated on the validation block, scored on the test block

Level 90%. `global` is one quantile for all windows; `regime_aware` is one per regime known at prediction time. Coverage is reported on all test windows, in free flow, in congestion, and at the transition into congestion.
